subject.title: feat(sidebar): add Session Reset button alongside New Session

question: Should OpenClaw accept a persistent Control UI sidebar Reset session button once this branch is rebased, regenerated, and proven, or should reset stay behind existing command/session-detail surfaces?
rationale: The implementation primitive is straightforward, but the PR exposes a destructive session-state action in persistent navigation, so placement and copy need maintainer product intent before merge.

options.title: Accept after repair and proof
options.body: Allow the sidebar reset affordance if it is rebased onto the current UI, generated i18n is repaired, and proof shows it clears history while preserving the session key.

options.title: Move reset out of the sidebar
options.body: Require the affordance to live in a session detail or overflow action instead of persistent navigation.

options.title: Decline this product direction
options.body: Keep reset available through existing command/session primitives and close or supersede this PR after preserving the related issue context.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Allow the sidebar reset affordance if it is rebased onto the current UI, generated i18n is repaired, and proof shows it clears history while preserving the session key.

likelyOwner.reason: The current sidebar and route-owned Control UI implementation is most directly tied to this decision owner in recent source history.
